Chapter 868: Chapter 11: Within a Turn of the Hand (Subscribe Please)_2

The disturbance in time and space suddenly vanished.

A young man’s figure emerged amongst the high-altitude congregation of powerful beings on either side.

The young man’s sleeves fluttered as the Xuanhuang-colored force field descended; in just a mere moment, it suppressed the ultimate weapons of both the Prison Tribe and the Tuoba Ancient God.

“Who is that?”

The five powerful beings of the Prison Tribe instantly looked up at the young man, “It’s the Galaxy Master.”

“We’re in trouble.”

The five members of the Prison Tribe became tense.

Naturally, they were well aware of the Galaxy Master’s battle records—killing the bearer of the ultimate weapon, Ming Che, and thereby positioning the Galaxy Master at the very pinnacle among the tens of thousands of eleventh-rank battlers.

“Galaxy Master?”

The four Insect Race Hives grimaced, as the human civilization was inherently hostile to the Insect Race, and the sudden arrival of the Galaxy Master was clearly indicative of his intent.

“Let’s go.”

Without hesitation, three of the Insect Race Hives abandoned a huge number of Insect Race Warriors, transforming into streaks of light, fleeing into the distance.

In the eyes of the many eleventh-rank powerful beings of the Insect Race Alliance, unless it was one of the very strongest, no one else should entertain the thought of resisting upon encountering the Galaxy Master alone.

“Galaxy Master?”

Tuoba Ancient God, who was in the process of activating the ‘Bell-Shaped’ ultimate weapon, was in a state of utter chaos.

The core battlefield was vast and boundless, and even with knowledge of the Galaxy Master’s strength, Tuoba Ancient God believed that as long as he could hide within the war base, he could preserve his life.

But now? He hadn’t even reached the war base when he ran into the Galaxy Master.

“Can you escape?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the three frantically fleeing Insect Race Hives, his thought flickered, and the Xuanhuang force field crushed down; two of the Insect Race Hives exploded immediately, while the remaining one had a faint glimmer of light emerging on its surface.

“An ultimate weapon?”

Lin Yuan took another look.

With his current strength, even the Xuanhuang force field, which was a passive defense, could resist very few eleventh-rank lifeforms.

Boom.

Like an ocean, the Xuanhuang force field once again enveloped the similarly escaping Tuoba Ancient God.

The Bell-Shaped ultimate weapon spread its aura, briefly resisting the Xuanhuang force field, but Tuoba Ancient God felt a chill in his heart.

From the Insect Race warriors’ judgement of the Galaxy Master’s killing of Ming Che, as long as one was enveloped by the Xuanhuang force field released by the Galaxy Master’s ultimate weapon, it was very difficult to escape.

“Galaxy Master, the feud between you and the Insect Race has nothing to do with us, the Prison Tribe. If you want to deal with the Insect Race, go ahead, we’ll be leaving.”

The five powerful beings of the Prison Tribe seized the opportunity to also start escaping into the distance.

“You’ll stay too.”

Lin Yuan glanced at them, with no intention of letting the Prison Tribe go.

After all, it was an ultimate weapon; it couldn’t simply be let go.

Whirrr.

The Xuanhuang force field seemed tangible, suppressing and fixing the three ultimate weapons in place.

“Galaxy Master, do you really think you can outlast the three of us?”

The five powerful beings from the Prison Tribe were furious and shocked. Inside the Xuanhuang force field, they struggled to move, as though they were in a bog.

Ultimate weapons cannot be destroyed; the only way to kill a holder of an eleventh-rank ultimate weapon was to exhaust them.

To outright deplete the holder of the ultimate weapon until they could no longer activate it.

“Let’s try.”

If Lin Yuan used his full strength, the mighty beings from both the Insect Race and the Prison Tribe wouldn’t last long.

But there was no need.

Already trapped in the pot, life and death were in Lin Yuan’s hands; there was no need to expose more.

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, more than an hour had passed.

Tuoba Ancient God was starting to falter.

“Galaxy Master, as long as you can spare me, any condition can be arranged…” Tuoba Ancient God communicated through transmission.

He still wanted to attempt reaching the ultimate, even if the chances weren’t high, but he had to try. What if he succeeded? Stepping into the Twelfth Layer, his might would shake the Cosmic Starry Skies, and he might even become one of the rulers of a peak power.

But now, all of this was impossibly distant from the Tuoba Ancient God.

“No need.”

Lin Yuan shook his head. With his current strength, Tuoba Ancient God was of no use to him, even taking him as a servant was considered bothersome.

Half an hour later.

A resolute expression appeared on the face of Tuoba Ancient God. He began to burn everything he could, desperately trying to activate his most powerful weapon to break free from the Xuanhuang Force Field’s bindings.

But alas, it was all in vain. In the end, the aura of that bell-shaped supreme weapon rapidly depleted, and Tuoba Ancient God, under the omnipresent cover of Xuanhuang Force Field, perished into dust.

The vastness of blood essence and soul power, under the refinement of the Primal Force, transformed into the purest Origin Power and was absorbed by Lin Yuan into his inner world.

“Dead?”

Lin Yuan put away the bell-shaped supreme weapon, glanced at it casually, and then put it into his inner world.

“Hm?”

Lin Yuan’s eyebrows suddenly shot up.

In the instant that Tuoba Ancient God perished within the Xuanhuang Force Field.

Lin Yuan clearly felt that the karmic connection between himself and Tuoba Ancient God had unexpectedly disappeared.

Such a situation only posed two possibilities.

One was that Tuoba Ancient God’s comprehension of the laws of causality far surpassed Lin Yuan’s, allowing him to easily conceal his own causal thread.

But this possibility was practically zero. Comprehending the laws wasn’t something achieved overnight. A second ago Lin Yuan could still easily perceive Tuoba Ancient God’s causal thread, and the next second he could no longer feel it? Tuoba Ancient God’s understanding of the laws of causality surpassed Lin Yuan’s in just an instant?

Too unrealistic.

The second possibility was that Tuoba Ancient God had thoroughly perished.

The dead Tuoba Ancient God naturally had all causality cease, and for Lin Yuan to not feel the connection to the other party was quite normal.

“So Tuoba Ancient God actually entered the battlefield with his true body?”

Lin Yuan felt slightly surprised in his heart.

Only when the true body perished, all avatars would also perish, and the causal threads would disappear directly.

“That’s right, the two-dimensional world just ended not long ago, Tuoba Ancient God didn’t have the time to condense new avatars. Moreover, protected by a supreme weapon, sending out his true body into battle was entirely possible.”

Lin Yuan quickly understood in an instant.

Although sending out the true body into battle was a great risk.

But risk also signified opportunity. The strength of the true body was stronger than that of the avatars, with many hidden trump cards at hand, its final explosive power also greatly surpassed that of the avatars.

If the true body entered the battlefield, coupled with a supreme weapon, Tuoba Ancient God’s ability to preserve his life went without saying.

“Indeed, it’s the true body, carrying many treasures.”

Lin Yuan casually checked Tuoba Ancient God’s spatial bracelet. There, he found a huge amount of resources and treasures.

Since Tuoba Ancient God had decided to join the battle with his true body, he naturally brought all the accumulated treasures with him; after all, if the true body perished, these resources and treasures would lose all significance.

Tuoba Ancient God, being a uniquely solitary lifeform without the encumbrance of a race, did not have the notion of leaving the resources and treasures outside to pass on to descendants.

“This makes for a tidy profit.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face. Not to mention the gains from killing Tuoba Ancient God, completely slaying a level 11, fifth-tier mighty being, in human civilization, meant a large number of merit points.

…

After the death of Tuoba Ancient God.

That Insect Race Hive and the five mighty beings from the Prison Tribe, also could not hold on and died within Lin Yuan’s Xuanhuang Force Field. Everything transformed into the most refined Origin Power, becoming the sustenance for the cultivation of Lin Yuan’s “Xuanhuang Physique”.

He put away two supreme weapons, and took the time to tally up the other gains.

A sense of emotion welled up in Lin Yuan’s heart.

“Initially facing Tuoba Ancient God, I could only rely on the deterrent power of human civilization to oppress him, but in truth, Tuoba Ancient God never took me seriously, otherwise he wouldn’t have taken the opportunity to ‘extort’.”

“Tuoba Ancient God, as an Eleventh Layer Ancient God, at that time I was only at the Ninth Layer. If it weren’t for human civilization, Tuoba Ancient God wouldn’t even spare me a second glance… But now, even with a supreme weapon in hand, Tuoba Ancient God died at my hands, and killing him was no different from stepping on an ant.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself: “Strength, this is absolute strength.”

A strong desire to become stronger emerged in Lin Yuan’s heart. He was now able to kill Tuoba Ancient God, but Twelfth Layer supreme beings might also be able to kill him.

In front of supreme beings, there was no way he could contend, and he could only hide within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm and barely protect himself.

“I must become a supreme being.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was resolute, only by becoming a supreme being would he truly have the capital to roam across this universe, not being seen as an insignificant ant by ultimate existences.
